press_references.value: Flywire And UBION Partner To Enhance Tuition Payments For International Students In Korea

partnership_announcements.description: Flywire and UBION have announced a new partnership to enhance tuition payments for international students in Korea by integrating Flywire’s payment platform with UBION’s educational services, simplifying cross-border tuition payments and improving efficiency for students, parents, and institutions.

press_references.value: Flywire and Avanse Financial Services Announce Strategic Partnership to Digitize Student Loan Disbursements from India

partnership_announcements.description: Flywire Corporation and Avanse Financial Services have announced a strategic partnership to digitize student loan disbursements from India, enabling streamlined payment flows for Indian students studying abroad. The integration allows students to process education loan payments in Indian rupees and track transactions to their universities, enhancing transparency and compliance.

press_references.value: Flywire and Ascensus Deliver over $2 Billion in 529 College Saving Plan Payments as Demand for Education Affordability Increases

partnership_announcements.description: Flywire and Ascensus have partnered to deliver over $2 billion in electronic 529 tuition payments to U.S. colleges and universities in 2024, expanding digital payment capabilities to over 750 institutions and more than 40 Ascensus-administered 529 savings programs.

press_references.value: Flywire and Blackbaud Partner to Streamline Tuition Payment Experience for International K-12 Students in the U.S.

partnership_announcements.description: Flywire and Blackbaud have partnered to enhance the tuition payment process for international K-12 students in the U.S., integrating Flywire's payment solutions into Blackbaud's platform.

overview_description.description:
Flywire is a payments enablement and software company. It combines its proprietary payments network, next-gen payments platform, and vertical-specific software to deliver the most important and complex payments for clients and their customers.

Flywire supports 4,000 + clients with diverse payment methods in more than 140 currencies across 240 countries and territories around the world. Flywire is headquartered in Boston, MA, USA with global offices.

about_short_description.short_description: Flywire is a payments enablement and software company that simplifies complex payments for its clients and their customers.

product.name: Flywire Global Payment Platform
product.description: A regulated, multi-rail payment platform for collecting, processing, reconciling, and settling domestic and cross-border payments in multiple currencies and local payment methods.

product.name: Flywire Education Tuition Management
product.description: A tuition payment and management solution that helps educational institutions and recruitment agents collect domestic and international student payments, track payment status, and reconcile funds.

product.name: Flywire B2B Invoice-to-Cash
product.description: An embedded payment and billing solution that supports cross-border invoice collection, payment processing, settlement, and reconciliation for businesses.

product.name: Flywire Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management
product.description: A healthcare payment solution that provides patients with online and in-person payment options and helps providers manage, reconcile, and settle patient accounts.

product.name: Flywire Travel Payments
product.description: A payment solution for travel operators, destination management companies, and hospitality organizations to collect international bookings, supplier, and hotel event payments.
